notes_for_editor: Dates and location agree across NHLR, NRHP and Forest Lookouts: 1928 replacement on Lemmon Rock, 1988 NRHP listing, 1997 NHLR registration, June 2015 closure to visitors. The current status is not confirmed: the latest notice read is the 2015 closure and no reopening was found. Design is thin: the sources read say only lookout house, building, architect unknown; a search snippet from the GVRHC Lemmon Rock PDF describes a ground-mounted L-4 structure, but that page was not read because the page-read budget was spent (not used in the story). The NRHP nomination PDF returned HTTP 403 and an Arizona Daily Star article returned HTTP 429, so neither was read. Wikidata lists elevation 8,773 ft against NHLR 8,720 ft (2,658 m); the record's 2657.9 m matches NHLR, so NHLR is followed. A Historical Marker Database snippet calls it the oldest lookout still in use on the Forest; not used because the page was not read. Record kind 'ground' is consistent with the NRHP building record but no source read states it in those words. Record access 'unknown' should now read closed (2015 notice), not confirmed for today.
